commonQuestions.question: Which financing type is right for my business?
commonQuestions.answer: It depends on your use of funds, time in business, revenue, and how quickly you need capital. SBA loans suit longer-term needs and larger amounts; lines of credit suit ongoing cash-flow gaps; equipment and factoring solve specific needs. Fund44 matches your profile to the paths that fit.

commonQuestions.question: Can I be matched to more than one option?
commonQuestions.answer: You may see one or more relevant paths depending on your business profile, financing need, and provider availability. Fund44 surfaces them together so you can compare structure and fit rather than committing to the first product you find.

commonQuestions.question: Are SBA loans always the best option?
commonQuestions.answer: Not always. SBA loans often offer favorable terms but involve more documentation and time. For urgent working-capital needs, a line of credit or term loan may fit better. The right answer depends on your situation.
